## Not adopted

### `create-beads-orchestration` — rejected

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

A whole-framework installer, not a skill: bootstrap.py overwrites an existing CLAUDE.md and .claude/settings.json wholesale (bootstrap.py:594, 612-616), gitignores .beads/ against our tracked-beads policy (bootstrap.py:634 vs .beads/beads.md:23-26), and generates supervisors by WebFetching third-party prompts. Exactly what curation.md means by importing a whole catalog; our execution skill + delegation rule + beads workflow already own this bucket. The root SKILL.md and skills/ copy are byte-identical; the dogfooded .claude/skills copy is stale (passes a --claude-only flag bootstrap.py no longer defines).

### `enforce-bead-for-supervisor.sh` — deferred

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

The gap it closes is real — nothing stops dispatching an implementer with no tracked bead — but the mechanical check needs a convention we have not mandated: a bead id field in every dispatch brief. Re-open when the execution skill's brief format requires that field; then this becomes a one-check PreToolUse:Task hook.

### `enforce-concise-response.sh` — rejected

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

Emits hookSpecificOutput.warning, undocumented for PostToolUse, so it is ignored; self-described as non-blocking. Our task-engine already states a richer result-size contract; a broken length cap adds nothing.

### `enforce-sequential-dispatch.sh` — deferred

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

Three checks: the closed-bead guard (:29-35) is a genuine gap for us (closed beads are our durable rejection record with nothing preventing a re-claim) and is deferred into bead cr-ghw; the blocker check is redundant for us (bd ready --parent is dependency-truth by construction); the design-doc check presupposes the architect flow that deadlocks at this pin. Only the first survives, as cr-ghw.

### `handoff` — rejected

*mattpocock_skills · `84fdeff` · ruled in round-001-council-consolidation*

16 lines whose trigger the absorbing skill already owns. The judge distinguished this from receiving-code-review deliberately: that is a substantial protocol with a distinct actor-moment and no kept skill claiming its trigger; this is not.

### `log-dispatch-prompt.sh` — deferred

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

The single most valuable mechanism in TCP: PostToolUse:Task auto-appends the dispatch prompt onto the bead as a DISPATCH comment (:30-37) — zero agent cooperation, and it closes our real gap that execution briefs live in gitignored scratchpad and are unrecoverable after a workstream closes. Deferred into bead cr-n0v because it carries a policy question the user must settle (a hook writing to bd vs conservative authority) plus truncation/disclosure design; reimplement, never copy.

### `nudge-claude-md-update.sh` — rejected

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

A PreCompact nudge to update a '## Current State' CLAUDE.md section; PreCompact stdout effectiveness is unconfirmed, and our durable-state story is beads + learnings.md + MEMORY.md, not a mutable CLAUDE.md section.

### `remind-inprogress.sh` — rejected

PreToolUse plain-text stdout is debug-logged, never added to model context — the hook cannot do its job as wired; and the content it would inject is already mandated by our execution skill's claim step.

### `scout` — rejected

*The-Claude-Protocol · `af754ef` · ruled in round-008-claude-protocol*

Read-only locator persona (haiku, Read/Glob/Grep). Our built-in Explore agent covers read-only fan-out; the fixed EXPLORATION/FINDINGS report scaffolding spends tokens without adding a check.
